brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

finish.summary: I built a compact unit from four bases on one level: three full bases at (0,0), (1,0) and (1,-1), plus a south half base at (0,1). A drawer sits on the half base's cut face. A mount spike stands where the three full bases meet and holds a small platform. Two joint bolts lock the bases together. The final check passed with no rule errors and the 3D shapes don't collide. Thirteen open edges could still take caps (that's a note, not an error). This checks fit only, not strength.

requirements.evidence: Four bases on a single level (piece:0,0,0, 1,0,0, 1,-1,0 full and 0,1,0 half-s), locked by jointBolt:0#0,0#0 and #1. The LOOSE_BODY warning is gone after adding the bolts.
drawer:0#0,1#cut sits on the cut (north) face of the half base at (0,1).

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|1,-1|1,0 (mount type) stands where (0,0), (1,-1) and (1,0) meet. My first choice of corner, (0,0)/(0,1)/(1,0), was refused (SPIKE_CLASH) because the drawer fills it, so I added a base at (1,-1) to make this corner.

requirements.requirement: Small platform held by the spike
requirements.evidence: A small platform (platform-sm) is on the mount spike. The first spike I placed was a type that can't carry a platform, so I replaced it with a mount spike.
The final check passed: no rule errors, shapes don't collide. Only an info note about 13 open edges that could take caps.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
